description.p: Sufi Email is a lightweight, configurable email client built with Rust and Tauri. It connects to standard IMAP/SMTP accounts, fetches mail and sends messages, and keeps a local cache so folders, messages, bodies and attachments stay readable offline.

ul.li: Conversation threading and a three-column reading UI
HTML and plain-text rendering in a sandboxed frame
Attachments: download, inline previews, and attaching when composing
New-mail notifications and a system tray
Multiple accounts and an offline read/unread queue
